newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded differentials ease.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded differentials ease.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline differentials eased on Thursday, giving back gains from a day earlier and pushing spot prices lower, traders said.

Diesel differentials were largely unchanged for a second straight day and prices in the spot Chicago and Group Three markets were tracking a nearly half cent gain in front-month heating oil in early afternoon trade, traders said.
"The market is really hard to assess right now," one trader said of thin talk that held differentials steady in early trade.
Group Three unleaded for prompt and later April deliveries was talked even to 0.25 cent a gallon under NYMEX May unleaded, with premium steady at 3.50 cents higher.
Chicago unleaded was talked 0.25/0.50 cent a gallon over the print, with premium barrels unchanged at 5.50 cents a gallon higher.

Group Three high and low sulphur differentials were steady for a second straight day at bids 6.0 cents a gallon over the print for prompt deliveries and 5.25 cents over for later barrels, traders said.
Chicago low sulphur diesel was bid 4.50 cents a gallon over May NYMEX unleaded for all April timings, with high sulphur remaining 2.50/2.75 cents over the print, both unchanged.
